items.title: Jalon Daniels could start in Week 11 for Buccaneers
items.desc: Jalon Daniels could start for the Bucs on Sunday against the Lions.
items.impact: The status of Baker Mayfield is unclear as he deals with a foot strain. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.title: Baker Mayfield (foot) uncertain for Week 11
items.desc: Baker Mayfield is uncertain for Week 11 as he deals with a foot strain.
items.impact: Mayfield will need to be monitored in practice this week. If he sits, Jalon Daniels would start on Sunday against the Lions.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenneth Walker III (groin) could sit Week 11
items.desc: Ian Rapoport said he "wouldn't be surprised" if Kenneth Walker sat in Week 11 to make sure that his groin is fully healed.
items.impact: The Chiefs enter this week as huge favorites against the Cardinals. Emmett Johnson could get another week to be in the workhorse role in the Chiefs backfield.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Xavier Restrepo promoted to active roster
items.desc: Xavier Restrepo has been promoted to the Titans active roster following the team placing Wan'Dale Robinson on IR with an ankle injury.
items.impact: Restrepo could have some sneaky PPR usage as the Titans primary slot receiver for the next few weeks. His floor and ceiling will likely be on the low end, but the usability could still be there for those in a pinch.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) placed on Injured Reserve
items.desc: Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) has been placed on Injured Reserve with an ankle injury.
items.impact: With Robinson out, the Titans promoted Xavier Restrepo to the active roster. Robinson will miss a minimum of four games. Restrepo on the other hand, could see some PPR viability as a primary slot receiver.
